svg.title: Manual tuning of the heater's PI
svg.desc: Raising Kp to 2.4 makes the integral time 4.8 s and the load recovery ends later, at 31.7 seconds. Raising Ki to 0.6 makes the integral time 3.3 s: the setpoint trial peaks at 38.02 degrees Celsius and the load trial is within 0.2 degrees from 25.4 seconds, so both trials pass.
svg.text: Manual tuning of the heater's PI: one gain at a time
Control Studio recordings of this project · same hot start and events · numbers answer the predictions
Kp 2.4: Ti 4.8 s, outside 0.2 °C until 31.7 s
Ki 0.6: Ti 3.3 s, small overshoot, peak 38.02 °C
